examplePersian: این دستگاه هزینه کل را در کمتر از یک ثانیه محاسبه می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A computer is a machine that stores and processes information.
example: The library lends a computer to each student for a whole term.
examplePersian: کتابخانه یک رایانه را برای یک ترم کامل به هر دانشجو می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Computers are machines that store and process information for people.
example: Schools are required to provide computers for every classroom.
examplePersian: مدارس موظف‌اند برای هر کلاس درس رایانه تهیه کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To conceal something means to hide it so that people cannot see or know about it.
example: The report was written in a way that conceals the true cost of the project.
examplePersian: گزارش طوری نوشته شد که هزینه واقعی پروژه را پنهان کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To concede something means to admit that the other side has a point.
example: The minister conceded that the old figures were unreliable.
examplePersian: وزیر تسلیم شد که ارقام قدیمی قابل اعتماد نبودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To conceive of something means to imagine it or think of it as possible.
example: It is hard to conceive of a city without any parks.
examplePersian: تصور شهری بدون هیچ پارکی دشوار است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To concentrate means to give all your attention to one thing.
example: Noise from the road made it hard to concentrate on the text.
examplePersian: سر و صدای جاده تمرکز بر متن را دشوار می‌کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A conception is an idea or a way of understanding something.
example: The survey tested the public conception of the proposed park.
examplePersian: نظرسنجی مفهوم عمومی از پارک پیشنهادی را بررسی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A concern is a worry about something that may go wrong.
example: The main concern of the jury was the reliability of the witness.
examplePersian: دغدغه اصلی هیئت منصفان قابل اعتماد بودن شاهد بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A concert is a live musical performance for an audience.
example: The concert hall seats more than two thousand people.
examplePersian: سالن کنسرت بیش از دو هزار نفر را در خود جای می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Concerted means planned or done by several people working together.
example: The plan failed because there was no concerted effort to raise money.
examplePersian: این طرح شکست خورد چون تلاش دست‌جمعی برای جذب وجوه وجود نداشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A concession is something one side gives up in order to reach an agreement.
example: As a concession, the company agreed to pay for the repairs itself.
examplePersian: شرکت به عنوان بستانه قبول کرد هزینه تعمیرات را خودش بپردازد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Concessions are things one side gives up in order to reach an agreement.
example: The final offer included concessions on wages and working hours.
examplePersian: پیشنهاد نهایی شامل بستانه‌هایی درباره دستمزد و ساعت کاری بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Concise means short and clear, using as few words as possible.
example: The report is concise, yet it covers every point of the debate.
examplePersian: این گزارش موجز است اما همه نکات بحث را پوشش می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A conclusion is the last part of a discussion, or the opinion you reach after thinking.
example: The committee reached the conclusion that the plan was too costly.
examplePersian: کمیته به این نتیجه رسید که طرح بیش از اندازه پرهزینه است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To concoct something means to invent it in an unusual and clever way.
example: The cook concocted a meal from what was left in the cupboard.
examplePersian: آشپز از آنچه در کمد مانده بود غذایی سرهم کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Concrete means existing as a real solid thing rather than as an idea.
example: The report gives no concrete evidence that the plan will work.
examplePersian: این گزارش هیچ مدرک ملموسی ارائه نمی‌دهد که طرح کار کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To condemn something means to say publicly that it is completely wrong.
example: MPs from both parties condemned the decision to close the hospital.
examplePersian: نمایندگان هر دو جناح تصمیم بستن بیمارستان را محکوم کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To condense something means to make it shorter without losing the main ideas.
example: The editor condensed the report to a single page.
examplePersian: ویراستار گزارش را در یک صفحه خلاصه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A condition is the particular state that a person or thing is in.
example: The old books are in poor condition and cannot be lent out.
examplePersian: کتاب‌های قدیمی در وضعیت نامناسبی هستند و قابل امانت دادن نیستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Conditions are the circumstances in which something happens.
example: Poor road conditions delayed the delivery for a week.
examplePersian: شرایط بد جاده تحویل را یک هفته به تأخیر انداخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A condolence is a word of sympathy you offer someone who has lost somebody they loved.
example: She sent a card of condolence after the funeral.
examplePersian: پس از خاکسپاری کارت تسلیت فرستاد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Conducive to something means likely to encourage it.
example: A quiet room is more conducive to study than a noisy kitchen.
examplePersian: اتاقی ساکت بیش از آشپزخانه پرسروصدا به مطالعه کمک می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To confer with someone means to discuss something with them formally.
example: The minister conferred with local officials before the announcement.
examplePersian: وزیر پیش از اعلام با مقامات محلی مشورت کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A conference is a large meeting where people talk about a particular subject.
example: The conference in Geneva brought together scientists from thirty countries.
examplePersian: کنفرانس ژنو دانشمندان سی کشور را گرد هم آورد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To confess something means to admit that you have done it, especially something wrong.
example: The driver confessed to causing the accident.
examplePersian: راننده اعتراف کرد که باعث تصادف شده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Confidence is the feeling that you can do something well, or that it will succeed.
example: The course gave me the confidence to apply for a new job.
examplePersian: این دوره به من اطمینان لازم را برای درخواست شغل تازه داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Confident means sure that something will happen, or sure of your own ability.
example: Engineers are confident that the bridge will open in time.
examplePersian: مهندسان مطمئن‌اند که پل به‌موقع باز خواهد شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Confidential means kept secret because it is private or sensitive.
example: Staff files are confidential and may not be shown to visitors.
examplePersian: پرونده‌های کارکنان محرمانه است و نباید به بازدیدکنندگان نشان داده شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A configuration is the way in which the parts of a system are arranged.
example: The file can be shared once the security configuration is correct.
examplePersian: این فایل پس از درست شدن چیدمان امنیتی قابل اشتراک‌گذاری است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To confine something means to keep it within a limited space or range.
example: The new rule confines fishing boats to the shallow waters.
examplePersian: قانون تازه قایق‌های ماهی‌گیری را به آب‌های کم‌عمق محدود می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To confirm something means to say that a fact, booking or order is now certain.
example: Please confirm your booking by email before Friday.
examplePersian: لطفاً رزرو خود را تا پیش از جمعه با رایانامه تأیید کنید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A confirmation is an official statement that something has been approved or is certain.
example: You will receive a confirmation of the result within ten working days.
examplePersian: ظرف ده روز کاری تأییدیه نتیجه را دریافت خواهید کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A conflict is a serious disagreement, or a fight between two sides.
example: The border conflict between the two states lasted six months.
examplePersian: درگیری مرزی میان دو کشور شش ماه طول کشید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To conform means to behave according to accepted rules or expectations.
example: New uniforms make it easier for staff to conform to the dress code.
examplePersian: یونیفرم تازه پیروی از پوشش رسمی را برای کارکنان آسان‌تر می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To confront someone means to face them, or to deal with a difficult problem.
example: The new manager had to confront a backlog of unpaid bills.
examplePersian: مدیر تازه باید با انبوهی از قبوض پرداخت‌نشده روبه‌رو می‌شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To confuse two things means to make people think that they are the same.
example: Passport and visa rules are so similar that travellers often confuse them.
examplePersian: قوانین گذرنامه و ویزا آن‌قدر شبیه‌اند که مسافران اغلب آن‌ها را اشتباه می‌گیرند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Confusion is a state in which you cannot understand or tell things apart.
example: There was some confusion about the time on the new departure board.
examplePersian: درباره ساعت تابلوی جدید رفتگان کمی سردرگمی وجود داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Congestion means a place is too crowded with traffic or people.
example: Heavy congestion on the ring road delayed every bus service.
examplePersian: ازدحام سنگین در بزرگراه حلقوی همه سرویس‌های اتوبوس را به تأخیر انداخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A congress is a large formal meeting, in some countries the law-making body.
example: The congress approved a new law on food labelling.
examplePersian: کنگره قانون تازه‌ای درباره برچسب‌گذاری مواد غذایی تصویب کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Congruent means exactly the same in size and shape, or in agreement.
example: The two triangles are congruent, so they have equal areas.
examplePersian: دو مثلث همسان‌اند، بنابراین مساحت برابری دارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A conjunction is a word such as and or but that joins two words or clauses.
example: The word although is a conjunction that joins two clauses together.
examplePersian: واژه هرچند حرفی ربط است که دو بند را به هم می‌پیوندد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To conquer something means to defeat it and take control of it by force.
example: The army conquered the city after a siege that lasted all winter.
examplePersian: ارتش پس از محاصره‌ای که تمام زمستان طول کشید شهر را فتح کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A conqueror is a person or country that defeats an enemy and takes control.
example: The conqueror failed to hold the province for more than a year.
examplePersian: فاتح نتوانست استان را بیش از یک سال در اختیار داشته باشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Conquest is the act of defeating an enemy and taking control of their land.
example: The conquest of the island took less than a month.
examplePersian: فتح جزیره کمتر از یک ماه طول کشید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Conscience is the inner sense of right and wrong that guides what you do.
example: He refused the offer because it went against his conscience.
examplePersian: او پیشنهاد را رد کرد چون برخلاف وجدانش بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Conscientious means doing your work carefully and thoroughly because you want to.
example: She is the most conscientious nurse in the whole hospital.
examplePersian: او وظیفه‌شناسترین پرستار کل بیمارستان است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Conscious means aware of something, and able to think about it deliberately.
example: Travellers should be conscious of the local laws before they arrive.
examplePersian: مسافران باید پیش از رسیدن نسبت به قوانین محلی آگاه باشند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Consecutive means following one after another, with nothing in between.
example: The team won five consecutive matches at the start of the season.
examplePersian: تیم در آغاز فصل پنج مسابقه پیاپی برد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A consensus is an opinion that most people in a group agree on.
example: There is a growing consensus among scientists that the limit is too high.
examplePersian: میان دانشمندان توافق نظری رو به رشدی وجود دارد که این حد بیش از حد بالاست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Consent means permission to do something, given freely by the person involved.
example: The survey was carried out with the written consent of every patient.
examplePersian: این نظرسنجی با رضایت کتبی هر بیمار انجام شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A consequence is a result that follows from something you did or decided.
example: Rising sea levels are a consequence of centuries of burning fuel.
examplePersian: بالا آمدن تراز دریا پیامد قرن‌ها سوخت‌سوزی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Consequent means following as a result of something, and therefore important.
example: The committee warned that the cuts would have a consequent effect on staffing.
examplePersian: کمیته هشدار داد که این کاهش‌ها اثر متعاقبی بر نیروی کار خواهد داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Conservation means protecting nature and using natural resources carefully.
example: Water conservation in dry areas saves millions of litres every year.
examplePersian: حفاظت از آب در مناطق خشک هر سال میلیون‌ها لیتر صرفه‌جویی می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Conservative means preferring traditional ideas and avoiding change or risk.
example: The committee took a conservative approach and changed very little.
examplePersian: کمیته رویکردی محافظه‌کارانه داشت و بسیار کم چیزی را تغییر داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A conservatory is a glass room where people grow plants that need warmth.
example: She grows tomatoes in a small conservatory behind the house.
examplePersian: او در گلخانه کوچکی پشت خانه گوجه می‌کارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To conserve something means to use it carefully so that it is not wasted.
example: Simple changes such as insulating windows conserve a lot of energy.
examplePersian: تغییرات ساده‌ای مانند عایق کردن پنجره‌ها انرژی زیادی صرفه‌جویی می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Considerable means large in amount, size or importance.
example: The repairs will cost a considerable amount of money.
examplePersian: تعمیرات هزینه قابل توجهی خواهد داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Considerate means showing care for other people and how they feel.
example: It was considerate of you to warn me about the delay.
examplePersian: اینکه درباره تأخیر هشدارم دادی ملاحظه‌کارانه بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To consign something means to send it officially to a place or a person.
example: The goods were consigned to a warehouse near the port.
examplePersian: کالاها به انباری نزدیک بندر ارسال شدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To consist of something means to be made up of those parts.
example: The course consists of theory, fieldwork and a written report.
examplePersian: این دوره از نظریه، کار میدانی و گزارش کتبی تشکیل شده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To console someone means to comfort them in a difficult moment.
example: She sat quietly beside him to console him after the news.
examplePersian: پس از شنیدن خبر، آرام کنارش نشست تا دلجویی‌اش کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To consolidate something means to combine parts so that the whole becomes stronger.
example: The new course consolidates what pupils learned in the first year.
examplePersian: دوره تازه آنچه دانش‌آموزان در سال اول آموخته‌اند را تثبیت می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Conspicuous means so noticeable that it draws attention to itself.
example: His absence from the meeting was conspicuous.
examplePersian: غیبت او از جلسه کاملاً به چشم آمد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A conspiracy is a secret plan made by a group of people to do something wrong.
example: Police uncovered a conspiracy to steal military documents.
examplePersian: پلیس توطئه‌ای برای سرقت اسناد نظامی را افشا کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Constant means staying at the same level all the time, or happening repeatedly.
example: Constant interruptions made it impossible to finish the report.
examplePersian: وقفه‌های مداوم اتمام گزارش را ناممکن کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A constituent is one of the separate parts that make up a whole group.
example: A city council has one constituent for every thousand residents.
examplePersian: شهرداری به ازای هر هزار ساکن یک واحد تشکیل‌دهنده دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To constitute something means to be the parts that make it up.
example: Women constitute half of the workforce in the region.
examplePersian: زنان نیمی از نیروی کار منطقه را تشکیل می‌دهند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A constitution is the set of rules that defines the rights and duties of a state.
example: The court ruled that the new law broke the constitution.
examplePersian: دادگاه حکم داد که قانون تازه قانون اساسی را زیر پا گذاشته است.

englishDefinition: To constrain something means to limit it or restrict your freedom to act.
example: A small budget constrained what the team could test.
examplePersian: بودجه انداز تیم را در آنچه می‌توانست آزمایش کند محدود کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To constrict something means to make it narrower, or to limit it.
example: Cold air constricts the blood vessels in the hands.
examplePersian: هوای سرد رگ‌های خونی دست‌ها را تنگ می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Construction is the work of building something, or the thing that is built.
example: Construction of the new ring road began in the spring.
examplePersian: ساخت بزرگراه حلقوی تازه در بهار آغاز شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To consult someone means to ask them for advice before deciding.
example: The committee consulted local residents before drawing up the plan.
examplePersian: کمیته پیش از تنظیم طرح با ساکنان محلی مشورت کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A consultant is a person who gives professional advice to a business or an organisation.
example: The council hired an outside consultant to review the costs.
examplePersian: شورا مشاوری بیرونی استخدام کرد تا هزینه‌ها را بررسی کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A consumer is a person who buys goods or services for their own use.
example: Consumers are comparing prices online before they buy.
examplePersian: مصرف‌کنندگان پیش از خرید قیمت‌ها را اینترنت مقایسه می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Consumption means the amount of something such as energy, fuel or food that people use.
example: Domestic consumption of water fell during the long dry summer.
examplePersian: مصرف خانگی آب در تابستان طولانی و خشک کاهش یافت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Contact means the state of being in touch with someone, or the person you speak to.
example: Please contact the office if you need a replacement ticket.
examplePersian: اگر به بلیت جایگزین نیاز دارید با دفتر تماس بگیرید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Contacts are the people you know, especially in your professional life.
example: Her contacts in the industry helped her find work quickly.
examplePersian: ارتباط‌هایش در این صنعت کمک کرد به‌سرعت کار پیدا کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A container is a box or vessel made to hold and transport something.
example: Every container returned to the port is checked for damage.
examplePersian: هر ظرف بازگشته به بندر از نظر آسیب بررسی می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Contaminants are substances that make something impure or unsafe.
example: Tests found chemical contaminants in water samples taken downstream.
examplePersian: آزمایش‌ها در نمونه‌های آب پایین‌دست آلاینده‌های شیمیایی یافتند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To contaminate something means to make it impure or unsafe by adding something harmful.
example: A leaking pipe contaminated the water supply for two days.
examplePersian: ترکیدن لوله، عرضه آب را برای دو روز آلوده کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To contemplate something means to think about it deeply before deciding.
example: The council is contemplating closing the smaller village schools.
examplePersian: شورا در حال سبک‌سنجی بستن مدارس کوچک روستا است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Contemporary means belonging to the present time, or to the same period as something.
example: The gallery shows contemporary art from the last ten years.
examplePersian: گالری هنر معاصر ده سال اخیر را به نمایش می‌گذارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Contempt is a feeling that someone or something deserves no respect at all.
example: She spoke of the proposal with open contempt.
examplePersian: او درباره آن پیشنهاد با تحقیر آشکار سخن گفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To contend that something means to argue that it is true, in a debate or report.
example: Economists contend that the recovery will be slow but steady.
examplePersian: اقتصاددانان استدلال می‌کنند که بهبود کند اما پیوسته خواهد بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The content of a book, film or page is everything that is in it.
example: The content of the course is organised around four main themes.
examplePersian: محتوای دوره حول چهار موضوع اصلی سازمان یافته است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A contention is an argument or claim that someone makes in a debate.
example: Her contention that the data were incomplete was never tested.
examplePersian: ادعای او مبنی بر ناقص بودن داده‌ها هرگز آزموده نشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The contents of a book, case or bag are the things inside it.
example: The contents of the box were marked with a faded label.
examplePersian: محتویات جعبه با برچسبی محو علامت‌گذاری شده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A contest is a competition in which people try to win a prize.
example: She won a national writing contest while still at school.
examplePersian: او در حالی که هنوز در مدرسه بود در مسابقه ملی نویسندگی برنده شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Context means the conditions and background in which something happens or is said.
example: No figure in the report is meaningful without the right context.
examplePersian: هیچ عددی در گزارش بدون بافت درست معنا ندارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A contingency is something that might happen and that you must plan for.
example: The plan includes money for every major contingency.
examplePersian: این طرح برای هر احتمال مهمی پول در نظر گرفته است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Continuity means the smooth joining of one part or episode to the next.
example: The film lacks continuity, and even regular viewers lose the plot.
examplePersian: این فیلم پیوستگی ندارد و حتی تماشاگران منظم هم داستان را گم می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A contract is a written legal agreement between two people or companies.
example: The contract must be signed by both sides before any work begins.
examplePersian: قرارداد باید پیش از آغاز کار توسط هر دو طرف امضا شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Contracts are written legal agreements that bind people or companies to do something.
example: Contracts with suppliers are reviewed at the end of every year.
examplePersian: قراردادهای تأمین‌کنندگان در پایان هر سال بازبینی می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To contradict someone means to say the opposite of what they have said.
example: The later report contradicts the earlier figures completely.
examplePersian: گزارش بعدی به‌طور کامل با ارقام پیشین در تناقض بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A contradiction is a statement that clashes with another statement, making both doubtful.
example: The report contains a contradiction that no editor noticed.
examplePersian: گزارش تناقضی دارد که هیچ ویراستاری متوجهش نشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A contrast is the clear difference between two things that you compare.
example: There is a sharp contrast between the two halves of the report.
examplePersian: میان دو نیمه گزارش تضاد آشکاری وجود دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To contribute to something means to give part of what you have in order to help it.
example: Regular exercise contributes to a lower risk of heart disease.
examplePersian: ورزش منظم در کاهش خطر بیماری قلبی نقش دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A contribution is an amount of money, effort or work given to a purpose.
example: Residents made a large contribution to the cost of the new hall.
examplePersian: ساکنان کمک مالی بزرگی به هزینه سالن تازه کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To contrive something means to succeed in doing something with great cleverness.
example: He contrived to finish the repairs a week ahead of schedule.
examplePersian: او چاره‌ای درخواست که تعمیرات یک هفته زودتر از برنامه تمام شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Control means the power to change or direct what happens in a situation.
example: The officer kept control of the meeting from start to finish.
examplePersian: آن مقام از ابتدا تا انتها کنترل جلسه را در دست داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Controversial means causing strong public disagreement and argument.
example: The decision to close the hospital remains deeply controversial.
examplePersian: تصمیم بستن بیمارستان همچنان به‌شدت بحث‌برانگیز است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution
